name: devflow-engine
description: AI-driven requirement delivery pipeline engine for the DevFlow competition.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @devflow/shared && npm run dev -w @devflow/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @devflow/shared && npm run dev -w @devflow/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @devflow/shared && npm run build -w @devflow/api && npm run build -w @devflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @devflow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @devflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @devflow/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:demo
